author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Adaptive choices layout (4-column 1-row, 2-column 2-rows A B / C D, and 1-column 4-rows A / B / C / D) for Question Bank and Interactive Quizzes to completely prevent text collision and overlap in long choices (such as expanded notation, list of numbers, and sentence explanations), specifically tested and verified on Grade 7 questions #10, #11, #12.
